import re
import sys

assignment = re.compile(
    r"\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:([0-9]+)|\(\s*\1\s*\+\s*([0-9]+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100)"
    r"\s*;\s*"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if match is None:
        continue

    name, direct, increment = match.groups()
    if direct is not None:
        values[name] = int(direct)
    else:
        values[name] = (values[name] + int(increment)) % 100

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; "
    f"TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
